svg.title: Measured impact
svg.desc: Hallucinations in agent workflows: 60% lower (LangGraph · prompt templates · systematic evals). Third-party model spend: 80% lower (fine-tuned and deployed a domain small language model). Time to complete an application: 60% lower (RAG platform on AWS Bedrock serving millions of users). Manual candidate screening: 90% lower (hackathon-winning hiring agent over 1M+ records). API security incidents: 60% lower (Azure API Management with OAuth2 and JWT). Database response time: 35% lower (MySQL schema tuning with JPA and Hibernate). At scale: 50,000+ concurrent users, dashboards over 25+ APIs, 90%+ test coverage, 35+ engineers trained.
